title: VP of Sales

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: GSG's sales organization serves sign manufacturers, large-format print companies, and vehicle wrap installers across 16 states—customers who directly experience the pain points Tedlar solves. The VP of Sales would care about Tedlar because: (1) Salespeople need differentiated products to win competitive deals and justify premium pricing—Tedlar's graffiti resistance, 12-20+ year outdoor lifespan, and UV protection provide concrete value propositions that help GSG's sales team close business against commodity-focused distributors; (2) Customer retention and account growth depend on solving real problems: When GSG's sign manufacturer customers face warranty claims from premature film failure or graffiti vandalism, Tedlar becomes a solution the sales team can proactively offer, deepening relationships and expanding wallet share; (3) GSG exhibits at ISA Sign Expo (2025 Booth #3325) and PRINTING United—the VP of Sales owns trade show strategy and needs premium products to showcase that attract qualified buyers and generate leads; (4) Sales team training and enablement around Tedlar's technical advantages (weather resistance -70°F to 230°F, no yellowing/cracking) equips reps to have consultative conversations with quality-focused customers, elevating GSG's position from transactional distributor to trusted advisor. Their KPIs around revenue growth, customer acquisition, and account penetration improve when the sales team can offer industry-leading protective films that solve high-value customer problems.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: As VP of Sales, [Name] owns revenue generation across GSG's 16-state footprint and manages the sales organization serving sign manufacturers, large-format printers, and vehicle wrap installers. This role has direct authority over product positioning, sales enablement strategy, and customer acquisition initiatives. [Name] likely reports to the President/CEO and oversees regional sales managers and field sales reps. Key responsibilities include: competitive win strategies, major account development, trade show ROI, and sales team performance metrics. Post-Grimco acquisition (January 2025), [Name] is likely involved in integrating sales processes and identifying portfolio gaps that affect competitive positioning.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: For [Name]'s sales organization, Tedlar's most relevant applications are: (1) Outdoor signage overlaminates for GSG's sign manufacturer customers facing warranty claims from UV damage and cracking—Tedlar provides a concrete solution sales reps can offer proactively; (2) Vehicle wrap protection for fleet graphics customers dealing with graffiti vandalism (spray paint, stickers)—Tedlar's easy-clean properties solve a high-visibility pain point; (3) Architectural graphics for building wraps and facades where extreme weather exposure (-70°F to 230°F) demands proven performance; (4) Transit interior wall protection where mold/mildew resistance and graffiti removal matter for public transportation customers. These use cases align directly with GSG's existing customer base (they already promote RTape for decals, banners, wall graphics) and give [Name]'s team differentiated selling points against commodity-focused distributors.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: [Name]'s KPIs center on revenue growth, gross margin expansion, customer retention rates, and new account acquisition. Personal motivations include: (1) Competitive differentiation—in wholesale distribution where many competitors carry similar 3M, Avery, and Oracal products, [Name] needs exclusive or premium lines that help sales reps win deals and command better pricing; (2) Sales enablement effectiveness—[Name] is accountable for equipping the team with products they can confidently sell based on technical superiority, not just price; (3) Customer problem-solving—when sign manufacturers come to GSG with failed overlaminates or graffiti issues, [Name] wants solutions in the portfolio that deepen relationships and expand wallet share; (4) Trade show performance—GSG's ISA Sign Expo booth (3325) needs compelling products to attract qualified traffic and generate pipeline, and Tedlar's proven track record provides credible differentiation at industry events. Tedlar's extreme durability and graffiti resistance directly reduce the warranty complaints and product failures that hurt customer satisfaction scores [Name] owns.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Multiple timing factors make NOW the optimal moment to engage [Name]: (1) The Grimco acquisition closed in January 2025, creating a 90-180 day window where portfolio decisions are actively being evaluated and supplier relationships rationalized—[Name] is likely assessing which product lines strengthen GSG's competitive position in the combined entity; (2) ISA Sign Expo 2025 where GSG has confirmed booth presence (#3325)—[Name] needs premium products to showcase that differentiate from competitors and justify booth investment; (3) Post-acquisition integration likely includes sales training updates and product positioning workshops where introducing Tedlar as a new premium line would fit naturally into [Name]'s enablement calendar; (4) GSG's recognition as Top Workplaces USA 2024 and active industry engagement (PRINTING United, ISA) signal organizational momentum and willingness to invest in growth initiatives. The combination of acquisition integration, confirmed trade show participation, and competitive pressure in wholesale distribution creates urgency for [Name] to secure differentiated products before competitors do.

personalization_hooks.hook: GSG's sign manufacturer and vehicle wrap customers likely experience warranty claims and service callbacks when overlaminates fail prematurely due to UV exposure or graffiti vandalism
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Position Tedlar as a tool that reduces the support burden on [Name]'s sales team by solving customer problems before they escalate—frame it as 'your reps spend less time handling complaints and more time growing accounts when customers use protective films that actually perform as promised'

personalization_hooks.hook: GSG exhibits at ISA Sign Expo 2025 (Booth #3325) where [Name] needs products that attract quality-focused sign manufacturers and justify premium positioning against commodity distributors
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Reference the upcoming show and position Tedlar as a booth differentiator—suggest a pre-show conversation about how [Name]'s team can use graffiti resistance and extreme weather performance as live demonstration points that competitors can't match

personalization_hooks.hook: The Grimco acquisition creates portfolio evaluation opportunities where [Name] can advocate for premium lines that strengthen GSG's competitive position in the combined distribution network
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Acknowledge the integration timing and frame Tedlar as a strategic addition that helps [Name]'s sales organization differentiate in an increasingly consolidated market—position this as the window to secure a supplier relationship before internal priorities shift post-integration

recommended_approach: Lead with competitive differentiation angle—[Name] is motivated by tools that help the sales team win against other distributors. Open by acknowledging GSG's ISA Sign Expo presence and the challenge of standing out in a crowded distribution market, then quickly pivot to specific customer pain points (warranty claims, graffiti issues) that [Name]'s team currently can't solve with existing overlaminates. Position Tedlar as a sales enablement asset, not just a product—emphasize how it gives reps concrete technical advantages to discuss with quality-focused customers. Close with a low-friction ask tied to trade show timing or a brief exploratory call about portfolio fit post-Grimco acquisition.
